item.name: Chocolate Keyboard
item.cardSummary: An early keyboard ASMR from common conveyor crates. Place it on your plot and walk on it for starter Cash while you open better crates.

item.name: Slime
item.cardSummary: A Rare slime ASMR from standard crate unboxing. Place it for Cash, and note it has appeared as a first-rebirth requirement in dated recordings.

item.name: Wax Taba Paw
item.cardSummary: A Legendary wax-style ASMR observed in the Index. Open higher-rarity conveyor crates and place it for stronger Cash per step than early commons.

item.name: Magma Slime
item.cardSummary: A Legendary slime variant. Unbox it from mid-to-high conveyor crates, place it on your field, and upgrade it when Cash allows.

item.name: Neon Pop-It
item.cardSummary: A Legendary pop-it ASMR from standard crate progression. Place it for Cash and pop sounds while you chase Mythic and Divine Index entries.

item.name: Wax Butter Squishy
item.cardSummary: A Legendary wax butter squishy ASMR. Comes from conveyor unboxing; place and walk it for mid-game Cash income.

item.name: RGB Keyboard
item.cardSummary: A Mythic keyboard ASMR. Target higher-rarity crates once your conveyor luck improves, then place it for stronger Cash ticks.

item.name: Water Droplets
item.cardSummary: A Mythic water-droplet ASMR from late conveyor crates. Place it on your plot for high-rarity Cash generation.

item.name: Chroma Keyboard
item.cardSummary: A Divine keyboard ASMR near the top of standard rarity labels. Unbox from high-tier crates and place it for late-ladder Cash.

item.name: Water Keyboard
item.cardSummary: A Divine water keyboard ASMR. Comes from high-end conveyor unboxing and pays well when placed and upgraded on your field.

item.name: Ice Tray
item.cardSummary: A Divine ice tray ASMR from top standard crates. Place it for Cash while you finish other Index gaps.

item.name: Squishy Dumpling
item.source: Conveyor crates (Squishy Dumpling Key Crate family)
item.cardSummary: A Divine dumpling ASMR tied to late dumpling crates. Place it for high Cash, but Limited and Exclusive toys still sit outside this standard track.

item.name: Honey Keyboard
item.cardSummary: A Honey-set keyboard from Honey crates. Honey weather raises Honey crate odds on the conveyor; place the keyboard for Cash when you unbox it.

item.name: Spoon
item.cardSummary: A Honey-set spoon ASMR from Honey crates. Hunt Honey weather or rare Honey crate spawns, then place it like other plot toys for Cash.

item.name: Honey Comb
item.cardSummary: A Honey-set honeycomb ASMR from Honey crates. One of the named Honey drops; place it for Cash when the event or conveyor gives you a Honey crate.

item.name: Lightning Keyboard
item.cardSummary: A Rebirth-track keyboard granted as a first-rebirth reward in dated recordings. Rebirth ASMRs stay when normal toys and Cash reset.

item.name: Golden Keyboard
item.cardSummary: The Exclusive Golden Keyboard from the VIP gamepass. Paid unlock that also pairs with VIP luck and cash buffs; it is kept through normal rebirth wipes.

item.name: Prismwave Keyboard
item.cardSummary: The Limited Prismwave Keyboard from the Limited Prismwave Keyboard Crate. Stock and Robux price can change; Limited ASMRs are kept on rebirth.
